posts.title: iPhone 18 lineup, iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max are projected to launch on September 18, 2026
posts.excerpt: The Apple iPhone 18 Pro, alongside the 18 Pro Max and the company’s first foldable iPhone, possibly called the iPhone Ultra, are all about to be announced in an event in September, it seems. A new report has now claimed a different date for the keynote which I think is wrong. Here’s when it will really be, along with every other part of the schedule — down to the minute.
